methodology.note: Engineering estimates, not measured intelligence, consciousness, or production availability. The current implementation/validation snapshot is anchored to exact code/test head b81ec539a1e2d442141e13929b376d2b549c9e64; Unified project integration suite, WorkPass110 continual-learning metrics, WorkPass108 paired evidence/promotion gate, and P26 Learning Validation all passed on this exact head. The runtime Node 24 + Python 3.12 setup, locked app/runtime installation, UI typecheck/build, runtime TypeScript, cognitive integration suite, governed approval E2E, 30-cycle substrate restore smoke, research bridge approval flow (NeuroCore/NOMEGA/DeepCode), and per-family distinct holdout task-coverage regressions passed. Learning-effectiveness and field-evidence scores remain unchanged because these changes strengthen integration/security gates rather than demonstrating higher real-world task success. Device/browser/Live2D/voice E2E, long soak, license review and reproducible release archive replacement remain open.

dimensions.implementationPercent: Estimated completeness of the implemented subsystem and its live runtime wiring.
dimensions.automatedValidationPercent: Estimated coverage of relevant automated contracts/regressions. It is not the percentage of tests that passed on the current head.
dimensions.fieldEvidencePercent: Strength of independently verified results on realistic external tasks. Synthetic fixtures and internal unit tests do not count as field evidence.
dimensions.releaseReadinessPercent: Estimated completion of clean-machine install, runtime services, UI/voice, security, soak, licensing and reproducible archive requirements.

methodology.scoreScale: 0 = absent/unproven; 100 = evidenced against the lane's full stated release requirements.
